lines.text: Many learners say: I live here since 2020.
Better: I have lived here since 2020.
Have lived! I have lived here since 2020.

native.tip: since가 나오면 현재완료! “I have lived here since 2020.”

en.tip: Use present perfect with since. Say “I have lived here since 2020”!
en.caption: Do you say “I live here since 2020” in English? 😅 Since means from then until now, so use the present perfect. “I have lived here since 2020” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
